title: Add multiple documents
detail: Choose up to 1000 documents. Each original is encrypted in this vault. Up to three independent readers use your configured model at a time and may incur charges. Financial checks still decide what can post.
session: Selected originals are encrypted in this vault before reading begins. Saved selections survive closing the app. Continue them here after reopening; completed readings are reused and uncertain requests are held for inspection.
stopping: Stopping; finishing active reads. Completed responses are retained. No further documents will start.
uncertain: The outcome is unknown for some selected documents. No further documents were started and nothing was retried. Inspect Statements and job activity before selecting those files again.
finished: Selection finished. Review each result; finished does not mean posted.
running: Reading selected documents. Finished results become available throughout the vault after each group of up to three documents. Figures cover posted records only; pending documents are excluded.
overLimit: Choose at most 1000 documents. Nothing was added.
pickerFailed: Documents could not be selected. Nothing was submitted.

reasons.not_a_regular_file: This is not a regular file
reasons.outcome_unknown: Outcome unknown; inspect saved documents before trying again

requestRefused: OrionViva could not accept this selection request. Check the selected files and job activity before trying again. Nothing was retried automatically.
paused: Import paused. {remaining} selected {documentNoun} {remainVerb}. Continue the saved selection when you are ready.
refused: The selection request was refused. Inspect the saved selection and job activity before trying again.
